payload.question: Total paid up share of Handloom in Rajasthan

payload.question: List non-covered GPs in madurai for Fishery
payload.sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, 0.00 AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%fishery%' WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE '%MADURAI%' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = 0) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

payload.question: List partially covered Gram Panchayats in lohit for PACS

payload.question: List partially covered Gram Panchayats in lohit for Fishery
payload.sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%fishery%' WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE '%ARUNACHAL PRADESH%' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE '%LOHIT%' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) < COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

payload.question: How many full covered GPs are there in thane for PACS?

payload.question: How many full covered GPs are there in faridabad for Dairy?
payload.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS covered_gp_count FROM (SELECT dbgv.gram_panchayat_name FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%dairy%' WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE '%HARYANA%' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE '%FARIDABAD%' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub;

payload.question: Latest top 10 Fishery rankings in tamil nadu

payload.question: Compare PACS rankings in uttar pradesh between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%UTTAR PRADESH%' AND (sector_name ILIKE '%PACS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%LAMPS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%FSS%') GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%UTTAR PRADESH%' AND (sector_name ILIKE '%PACS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%LAMPS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%FSS%') ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: Compare Housing rankings in west bengal between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%WEST BENGAL%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%WEST BENGAL%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: Compare Dairy rankings in tamil nadu between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%GUJARAT%' AND (sector_name ILIKE '%PACS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%LAMPS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%FSS%') GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%GUJARAT%' AND (sector_name ILIKE '%PACS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%LAMPS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%FSS%') ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: Compare Dairy rankings in gujarat between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%GUJARAT%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%GUJARAT%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: Give me list of covered GPs in mysore district in Multi-purpose sector
payload.sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%multi%' WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE '%KARNATAKA%' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE '%MYSORE%' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

payload.question: Compare Dairy rankings in uttar pradesh between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%UTTAR PRADESH%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%UTTAR PRADESH%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%WEST BENGAL%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%WEST BENGAL%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: List partially covered Gram Panchayats in bharuch for Handloom

payload.question: Compare Housing rankings in maharashtra between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%MAHARASHTRA%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%MAHARASHTRA%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: Compare Housing rankings in gujarat between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%GUJARAT%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%GUJARAT%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: Compare Housing rankings in tamil nadu between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: Compare PACS rankings in tamil nadu between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND (sector_name ILIKE '%PACS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%LAMPS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%FSS%') GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%TAMIL NADU%' AND (sector_name ILIKE '%PACS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%LAMPS%' OR sector_name ILIKE '%FSS%') ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;

payload.question: Compare Housing rankings in uttar pradesh between Q3 2025 and Q4 2025
payload.sql: WITH period2_data AS (SELECT cooperative_id, MAX(total_score) AS total_score, MIN(rank) AS rank FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026 AND state_name ILIKE '%UTTAR PRADESH%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' GROUP BY cooperative_id) SELECT t1.cooperative_id, t1.cooperative_name, t1.state_name, t1.sector_name, t1.total_score AS score_period_1, t1.rank AS rank_period_1, t2.total_score AS score_period_2, t2.rank AS rank_period_2, COALESCE(t2.total_score, 0) - t1.total_score AS score_diff, CASE WHEN t2.rank IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE t1.rank - t2.rank END AS rank_change FROM public.chatbot_cooperative_rankings AS t1 LEFT JOIN period2_data AS t2 ON t1.cooperative_id = t2.cooperative_id WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM t1.date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM t1.date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.date_time)=2025 AND t1.state_name ILIKE '%UTTAR PRADESH%' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Housing%' ORDER BY t2.rank ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15;
